description_en: Calls CreateMPULayout to create a stream relay layout
description_zh: 调用CreateMPULayout创建旁路直播布局
kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-mpu-layout --panes MajorPane=1 ZOrder=0 X=0.25 Y=0.25 Height=0.25 Width=0.25 PaneId=0 --app-id yourAppId --audio-mix-count 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMPULayout

fields.help_en: The height of the pane as a normalized percentage. Valid values of Height: 0.0<Height≤1.0
fields.help_zh: 窗格高，归一化百分比。Height取值范围：0.0<Height≤1.0
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
Specifies the major pane. Each layout can have only one major pane.

0: minor pane.
 
1: major pane
fields.help_zh:
指定主窗格，每个布局只能有一个主窗格。

0：副窗格。
 
1：主窗格
fields.name: major_pane

fields.help_en: The layout ID, which is sorted from the upper left to the lower right and starts from 0
fields.help_zh: 布局ID，从左上到右下排序，从0开始
fields.name: pane_id

fields.help_en: The width of the pane as a normalized percentage. Valid values of Width: 0.0<Width≤1.0
fields.help_zh: 窗格宽，归一化百分比。Width取值范围：0.0<Width≤1.0
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X coordinate as a normalized percentage. Valid values of X: 0.0≤X≤1.0
fields.help_zh: 坐标X，归一化百分比。坐标X取值范围：0.0≤X≤1.0
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate as a normalized percentage. Valid values of Y: 0.0≤Y≤1.0
fields.help_zh: 坐标Y，归一化百分比。坐标Y取值范围：0.0≤Y≤1.0
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 indicates the bottom layer, 1 indicates the layer above layer 0, and so on
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推
fields.name: z_order

parameters.help_en: The list of panes in the layout
parameters.name: panes

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Only a single ID can be passed.
You can create and query the application ID in the console
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。
您可以在控制台创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of audio mixes. Valid values: 0 to 6
parameters.help_zh: 最大混音个数。取值范围：0~6
parameters.name: audio_mix_count
